Load libraries
```{r, message=FALSE}
library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)
```


Load data
```{r}
OpenTargets_ALS_Genetic_ <- as.character(t(read.table(file = "data/OpenTargets/ranked_gene_sets/OT-MONDO_0004976-associated-targets-9_15_2026-v26_06_weights_genetics_only_ALS_ranked.csv")))
length(OpenTargets_ALS_Genetic_)


OpenTargets_BIP_Genetic_ <- as.character(t(read.table(file = "data/OpenTargets/ranked_gene_sets/OT-MONDO_0004985-associated-targets-9_15_2026-v26_06_weights_genetics_only_BIP_ranked.csv")))
length(OpenTargets_BIP_Genetic_)


OpenTargets_MDD_Genetic_ <- as.character(t(read.table(file = "data/OpenTargets/ranked_gene_sets/OT-MONDO_0002009-associated-targets-9_15_2026-v26_06_weights_genetics_only_MDD_ranked.csv")))
length(OpenTargets_MDD_Genetic_)


OpenTargets_PAR_Genetic_ <- as.character(t(read.table(file = "data/OpenTargets/ranked_gene_sets/OT-MONDO_0005180-associated-targets-9_15_2026-v26_06_weights_genetics_only_PAR_ranked.csv")))
length(OpenTargets_PAR_Genetic_)


OpenTargets_SCZ_Genetic_ <- as.character(t(read.table(file = "data/OpenTargets/ranked_gene_sets/OT-MONDO_0005090-associated-targets-9_15_2026-v26_06_weights_genetics_only_SCZ_ranked.csv")))
length(OpenTargets_SCZ_Genetic_)

```




```{r}
gene_lists <- list(
  ALS = OpenTargets_ALS_Genetic_,
  BIP = OpenTargets_BIP_Genetic_,
  MDD = OpenTargets_MDD_Genetic_,
  PAR = OpenTargets_PAR_Genetic_,
  SCZ = OpenTargets_SCZ_Genetic_
)

sapply(gene_lists, length)
```


```{r}
jaccard_index <- function(gene_lists) {
  n <- length(gene_lists)
  mat <- matrix(0, n, n)
  rownames(mat) <- colnames(mat) <- names(gene_lists)

  for (i in 1:n) {
    for (j in 1:n) {
      inter <- length(intersect(gene_lists[[i]], gene_lists[[j]]))
      union <- length(union(gene_lists[[i]], gene_lists[[j]]))
      mat[i, j] <- inter / union
    }
  }
  mat
}

jac_matrix <- jaccard_index(gene_lists)
jac_matrix

```



```{r}
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)

# Define the color mapping
col_fun <- colorRamp2(c(0, 1), c("white", "darkred"))

# Create the heatmap with numbers
h <- Heatmap(jac_matrix,
        name = "Jaccard",
        col = col_fun,
        cluster_rows = TRUE,
        cluster_columns = TRUE,
        show_row_names = TRUE,
        show_column_names = TRUE,
        row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 20),   
        column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 20),
        cell_fun = function(j, i, x, y, width, height, fill) {
            grid.text(sprintf("%.2f", jac_matrix[i, j]), x, y, gp = gpar(fontsize = 20))
        },
             heatmap_legend_param = list(
                 title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 20),   # legend title size
                 labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = 15)   # legend labels size
             ))

h
```


Save
```{r, eval=T}
# Open PDF device
pdf("plots/Jaccard_index_all_OT_genes.pdf", width = 8, height = 6)  # width & height in inches

h

# Close PDF device
dev.off()
```




Load Seurat object.
```{r}
se <- readRDS("Seurat_objects/Postnatal_human_seurat_v5_GNxEarly_filtered_trajectory_lineage_cells_harmony_no_outliers.rds")
se
head(se[[]])
```


```{r}
# Extract gene names from your Seurat object
gene_names <- rownames(se)

# Filter each gene list to keep only genes present in the Seurat object
gene_lists_filtered <- lapply(gene_lists, function(x) unique(x[x %in% gene_names]))

# Check lengths
sapply(gene_lists_filtered, length)

```



```{r}
# Example: define number of top genes per list
top_n_genes <- c(
  ALS = 90,
  BIP = 80,
  MDD = 160,
  PAR = 250,
  SCZ = 130
)

```



```{r}
#Subset each gene list
gene_lists_top <- mapply(function(genes, n) {
  # Take top n genes or all if list is shorter than n
  head(genes, min(length(genes), n))
}, gene_lists_filtered, top_n_genes, SIMPLIFY = FALSE)

sapply(gene_lists_top, length)
```



```{r}
jac_matrix_top <- jaccard_index(gene_lists_top)
jac_matrix_top
```


```{r}
# Define the color mapping
col_fun <- colorRamp2(c(0, 1), c("white", "darkred"))

# Create the heatmap with numbers
h <- Heatmap(jac_matrix_top,
        name = "Jaccard",
        col = col_fun,
        cluster_rows = TRUE,
        cluster_columns = TRUE,
        show_row_names = TRUE,
        show_column_names = TRUE,
        row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 20),   
        column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 20),
        cell_fun = function(j, i, x, y, width, height, fill) {
            grid.text(sprintf("%.2f", jac_matrix[i, j]), x, y, gp = gpar(fontsize = 20))
        },
             heatmap_legend_param = list(
                 title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 20),   # legend title size
                 labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = 15)   # legend labels size
             ))

h
```



Save
```{r, eval=T}
# Open PDF device
pdf("plots/Jaccard_index_top_genes.pdf", width = 8, height = 6)  # width & height in inches

h

# Close PDF device
dev.off()
```
